messages:
rhea.pm: Quick sync  drafting a minimal upgrade SLA for private installs (VPC + airgap). Need SRE, docs, and sales buy-in on what we can promise.

jon.sre: Propose three classes: hotfix (no schema, quick restart), minor (non-breaking rolling upgrade), major (schema or infra change -> blue/green). Each with explicit max control-plane disruption.

rhea.pm: I sketched numbers: hotfix <10m, minor <5m customer-visible, major planned window (2h) with staged tenant cutovers. Doable?

jon.sre: Hotfix <10m is reasonable if we can do image swap + quick health probe. Minor <5m depends on KV-cache warm strategy. We need a cache migration API.

viv.docs: For airgap installs we must include signed manifests, offline verifier steps, and a support bundle command that collects signed logs. Will add examples.

noah.sales: Customers insist on IP preservation during upgrades. Can we offer an "IP-preserve" installer mode as default for Enterprise?

jon.sre: Yes, we can add `--preserve-ips`. It should skip interface reprovisioning and restore routes. Need tests for overlapping CIDRs and multi-NIC.

rhea.pm: Draft launch gates: preflight passes, network contract signed (ports & IPs), readiness probe healthy, canary tenants report no errors for 24h, rollback validated.

jon.sre: Add: health-gate that verifies KV namespace consistency before traffic shift. Also default drain timeout 300s, overridable per customer.

viv.docs: I'll author CLI examples: `installer --preserve-ips --manifest ./bundle.sig --dry-run` and a troubleshooting section for NAT/overlapping CIDR.

noah.sales: I'll validate Enterprise wording with two customers this week. If accepted, we can make `--preserve-ips` non-default for Standard and default for Enterprise.

rhea.pm: Action items: Jon -> probe & migration API sketch; Viv -> offline verifier docs + CLI examples; Noah -> customer validation. I'll consolidate into RFC and cut PR by Wed. Post corner cases here (VPN tunnels, NAT64, ephemeral external IP pools).

jon.sre: Edge: external LBs that SNAT source IPs; recommend passthrough mode in network contract.

viv.docs: Edge: airgap cert rotation needs offline key escrow steps. Will document.

cli-bot: [cli-bot] created draft: /rfc/private-install/upgrade-sla-checklist-draft.md

rhea.pm: thanks all, will loop back after the PR.
